definitions.explanation: A portable space heater that burns kerosene (灯油) for fuel. Widely used in Japanese homes, especially in rural areas and older buildings without central heating.

examples.japanese: {石油|せきゆ}ストーブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: To turn on the kerosene heater.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{石油|せきゆ}ストーブ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}する→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: When winter comes, the kerosene heater gets a lot of use.

examples.japanese: {石油|せきゆ}ストーブ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧やかん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いて→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加湿|かしつ}→加湿：29748_kashitsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {石油|せきゆ}ストーブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つける / ⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧: to turn the kerosene heater on / off
- {石油|せきゆ}ストーブ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{灯油|とうゆ}→灯油：04071_touyu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to fill the heater with kerosene

CULTURAL NOTE:
Common in Japanese homes, many of which have no central heating. People set a kettle on top to humidify the room, and buy ⟦{灯油|とうゆ}→灯油：04071_touyu⟧ (kerosene) at gas stations or from delivery trucks that tour neighborhoods in winter.

WATCH OUT:
⟦{石油|せきゆ}→石油：01448_sekiyu⟧ here means kerosene, not gasoline; the fuel itself is called ⟦{灯油|とうゆ}→灯油：04071_touyu⟧, and the heater is also called a ⟦{灯油|とうゆ}→灯油：04071_touyu⟧⟦ストーブ→ストーブ：02906_sutoobu⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦ストーブ→ストーブ：02906_sutoobu⟧: electric heater
